question: Should this external PR wait for generated-HTML or browser proof from the current force-pushed text-only head before merge?
rationale: Repository policy makes real after-fix behavior proof a merge gate for external non-docs PRs, and the posted evidence exercises a sanitizer that no longer exists in the reviewed head.

options.title: Require current-head proof
options.body: Ask for a local Astro build or browser capture showing hostile description content is escaped or rejected and the normal dek renders correctly.

options.title: Override the proof gate
options.body: A maintainer may explicitly accept the direct schema-and-sink removal as sufficient despite the stale proof narrative.

recommendation.title: Require current-head proof
recommendation.body: Ask for a local Astro build or browser capture showing hostile description content is escaped or rejected and the normal dek renders correctly.

likelyOwner.reason: He authored and force-pushed the final implementation and is best positioned to decide whether its direct sink removal warrants a proof override.
